name: Spirit Blade: Infusion's combat-damage discount and Sword weapon buff
notes: Sets the CHAMP_DEALT_COMBAT_DMG global effect directly (normally set by a real combat hit) to reach the discount condition without scripting a full attack, then plays Spirit Blade: Infusion for 0 reserve and confirms it grants +3 power and an on-hit draw trigger to the target Sword weapon.

rulesClauses: This card costs 2 less to activate if your champion has dealt combat damage this turn.
Until end of turn, target Sword weapon gets +3 [POWER] and "On Champion Hit: Draw a card."
